5 تطوّى [It became folded with several, or many, foldings; or wound, or coiled;] quasi-pass. of 2. (TA.) You say, تَطَوَّتِ الحَيَّةُ The serpent wound, or coiled, itself. (S, TA.) And Sb mentions the phrase ↓ تَطَوَّى ٱنْطِوَآءً ; citing, as an ex., “وَقَدْ تَطَوَّيْتُ ٱنْطِوَآءَ الحَضْبَهْ
” [And I had writhed with the winding of the حضبة], meaning [by this last word] a species of serpent, or the bow-string. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
